# parts[0] = before first marker, parts[1] = label, parts[2] = content, etc.
data = {}
for i in range(1, len(parts)-1, 2):
    label = parts[i].strip()
    content = parts[i+1].strip()
    try:
        data[label] = json.loads(content)
    except:
        data[label] = content

print("Parsed sections:", list(data.keys()))
for k in data:
    if isinstance(data[k], dict):
        print(f"\n--- {k} ---")
        print(json.dumps(data[k], indent=2, default=str)[:800])
